Doctor recommends stress management and reducing sodium intake instead of increasing dosage. Taking a daily magnesium supplement, which may support blood pressure regulation.
core_memory.hypothyroidism_treatment: Hypothyroidism: On levothyroxine 75 mcg once daily. Taken on an empty stomach, at least 30 minutes before eating. Last TSH test result: 2.1 mIU/L(within normal range). Doctor has not adjusted dosage. Noticeable sluggishness if a dose is missed; uses a pill organizer to stay on track.

Takes meloxicam 7.5 mg when joints are particularly stiff(knees and hands), but only as needed due to concern about NSAID overuse. Doctor recommended glucosamine supplements; effect on symptoms is uncertain and not yet confirmed.
